ruling.recommended_action: Void the $5.00 no-show fee and refund the rider to the original payment method; no driver flag (no fraud, no repeat), but note the arrival-point mismatch (150 m, Gate B) in the driver's compliance log.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat [F10–F15], the complaint and the driver statement [F16] contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark, dangerous-driving or accident allegation; the dispute is a fee dispute only → safety_concern none.

NS-0: the driver cancelled and picked "rider_no_show", so NS-1/NS-2 apply (the app reason is his claim; his own chat/statement confirm he cancelled for no-show, so no NS-3).

NS-1 conditions: (i) arrival — driver tapped "I'm Here" at 21:26:00 [F6][F7] but was 150 m from the pickup point at that moment [F7], within the 200 m radius, so this holds; (ii) wait — arrival 21:26:00, cancellation 21:32:00, 6 min 0 s elapsed [F4][F6], past the 5-minute free wait (the later-of scheduled/arrival is 21:26:00); (iii) contact — 3 in-app messages (first 21:26:30) and 1 in-app call (21:27:30, unanswered) before cancelling [F5][F15], satisfying §2.3; (iv) continuous presence — stationary 6 min 0 s at a point 150 m from pickup, and within 200 m for 6 min 0 s after the tap [F2][F3][F7], no GPS gap.

However, all four NS-1 sub-conditions cannot make the fee "stand" unless the driver's waited position is the designated pickup point — instead the record shows he parked at Gate B while the pickup point was Gate A [F7][F10][F11][F12]; the rider asked him to come to Gate A ("I'm at Gate A, can you come here?" [F11]) and the driver refused ("Cannot stop at Gate A, double yellow line, please come to Gate B" [F12]), so the waiting was not performed "at the pick-up location according to GPS data" (A3, NS-1). The rider was at the correct pickup point [F11]; the driver stopped 150 m away at a different gate [F3][F7]. NS-2 therefore applies: any NS-1 condition failing → refund_full of the $5.00 charged [F8]. Amount = $5.00 (NS-1/§2.2 fee). No NS-2 flag: the driver did not mark arrival while away from the pickup point — 150 m is inside the 200 m tolerance [F2][F7] — so this is a pickup-point placement failure, not a fraudulent arrival mark. No repeat/no-show flags on either profile [F20][F21], so no NS-9 / RD-6 add-on; no NS-8 goodwill credit (the driver did arrive and did attempt contact).

element_findings.element: Driver arrived at pickup point ("I'm Here" + GPS at pickup, NS-1(i)/A3)
element_findings.reason: Tap at 21:26:00 was 150 m from the pickup point at Gate B while the rider waited at Gate A; the rider asked him to come to Gate A and he refused, so the wait was not performed at the pickup location.

element_findings.element: 5-minute free wait passed (later of scheduled pickup and arrival)
element_findings.reason: Arrival recorded 21:26:00, cancellation 21:32:00 — 6 min 0 s, beyond the 5-minute free wait from the later of the two.

element_findings.element: Driver sent >=1 in-app message AND >=1 in-app call before cancelling (NS-1(iii))
element_findings.reason: 3 in-app messages (first 21:26:30) and 1 in-app call (first 21:27:30, unanswered) before the 21:32:00 cancellation.

element_findings.element: Driver stayed at pickup point throughout (NS-1(iv))
element_findings.reason: Stationary 21:26:00–21:32:00 (6 min 0 s) 150 m from pickup, within 200 m for the whole 7-minute window; no GPS gap.
App reason rider_no_show and driver's own chat/statement confirm he cancelled over the no-show after waiting — NS-1/NS-2 route, not NS-3.
